d:
Can Congress overcome its internal differences and win back Punjab? And what would it do differently to tackle the state’s drug crisis?
In this Idea Exchange with The Indian Express, Congress leader and former Indian hockey captain Pargat Singh takes questions on Punjab politics, the Bhagwant Mann-led AAP government, the party’s chief ministerial face and whether Congress misses Captain Amarinder Singh.
He also discusses stubble burning and Delhi’s pollution, policing, youth opportunities and Punjab’s contribution to Indian hockey.
